payload.space: One genuine candidate set exists in this completion iteration - the JSON tree approach: J1 native details/summary elements rendered server-side (zero-dep, zero JS, collapsible by the browser itself); J2 a hand-rolled client-side JS tree walker (more control - expand-all, search - at the cost of script weight in the board page); J3 a vendored renderer library (most features, breaks the zero-dep ethos outright). Everything else in scope is allocation into blessed homes with no architectural alternative - the no-real-alternatives case to be argued at the gate, not padded into fake candidates.
